# Decompiled Source Handoff

Place the complete decompiler output here:

    DECOMPILED_SOURCE/

Preserve:
1. original package/class structure
2. original obfuscated identifiers
3. one source file per decompiled class where possible
4. decompiler version and command/options in DECOMPILER_METADATA.md
5. do not recompile or modify the original JAR

The decompiled source is a readability aid. For disagreements, use:
JAR bytecode > javap/classfiles > decompiler reconstruction > inference.

Once supplied, it can be indexed against CLASS_INDEX.tsv and METHOD_INDEX.tsv.
